correctness.rationale: The proof uses the fresh all-degree two-variance inequality and the monotonicity of centered power means. Equality at a finite exponent above two forces equality in the ordinary normalized L2-to-Lp power-mean inequality at a p-minimizing center, hence every root is equidistant from that center. After affine normalization all roots are on the unit circle and the root-to-critical Hausdorff distance is one. Rubinstein's boundary equality theorem then forces a regular-polygon polynomial. The converse follows from the unique central critical point and rotational symmetry.
